sketch: SSS => equal angles; x+60+2x=180 => x=40; frame1: 40/60/80; frame2 same.
statements: A carpenter builds two triangular frames.
Frame 1 has side lengths 5, 7, and 9 units.
Frame 2 is built with side lengths exactly 5, 7, and 9 units.
In frame 1, the angle opposite the side of length 7 is 60 degrees, and the angle opposite the side of length 9 is twice the angle opposite the side of length 5.
The three interior angles of any triangle add to 180 degrees.
Find all three angles of frame 2.
target: Frame 2's angles are 40, 60, and 80 degrees, opposite the sides of length 5, 7, and 9 respectively.

trace.concl: The two frames have pairwise equal side lengths.
from: Frame 1 has side lengths 5, 7, and 9 units
Frame 2 is built with side lengths exactly 5, 7, and 9 units

trace.concl: All corresponding angles of the two frames are equal.
from: If two triangles satisfy any one of these criteria, all corresponding sides and angles are equal

trace.concl: In frame 1, call the angle opposite the side of length 5 x; the angle opposite the side of length 9 is 2x and the angle opposite the side of length 7 is 60 degrees.
